domain: Brazilian CNES health registry — medical equipment/pharma sales
critical_rules: Always qualify tables: mcp_test.table_name (or set search_path to mcp_test)
Deactivated facility: deactivation_reason_code IS NOT NULL
Active professional at facility: termination_date IS NULL
Terminated professional: termination_date IS NOT NULL
Equipment in use: operational_status = 'E' AND quantity > 0
Prefer facility_search_view for facility discovery with aggregated counts
occupation_code is CBO Brazilian occupation/specialty code — join occupations for labels
Find specialists by occupation_name ILIKE (e.g. '%DERMAT%') or occupation_code (e.g. 225135)
facility_type_code = legal establishment type (HOSPITAL, AMBULATORIO); unit_type_code/unit_type_name = CNES unit classification (CONSULTORIO ISOLADO, CLINICA/CENTRO DE ESPECIALIDADE)
unit_subtype_name is populated for ~21% of facilities (CAPS level, UPA, hospital porte); NULL otherwise
Filter private vs SUS payment via facility_agreements + agreement_types (SUS, PARTICULAR, etc.)

agreement_types.description: Payment/agreement types (SUS, particular, health plan). From tbConvenio.

care_types.description: Care delivery modes (ambulatorial, internacao). From tbAtendimentoPrestado.

deactivation_reasons.description: Reasons why facilities are deactivated. Join facilities.deactivation_reason_code when NOT NULL.

equipment_catalog.description: Catalog of medical equipment types. Composite PK (equipment_code, equipment_type_code).

facilities.description: Health facilities/establishments - PRIMARY TARGET for sales. ~623k rows.

columns.name: trade_name
columns.comment: Business/trade name (most commonly used for display)

columns.name: deactivation_reason_code
columns.comment: NULL = ACTIVE facility, NOT NULL = deactivated (~24.5% deactivated)

columns.name: unit_subtype_name
columns.comment: Denormalized from rlEstabSubTipo + tbSubTipo; NULL if no subtype registered

example_queries: SELECT trade_name, unit_type_name, unit_subtype_name FROM mcp_test.facilities WHERE deactivation_reason_code IS NULL AND unit_type_code = '36' LIMIT 10

facility_agreements.description: Payment/care agreements accepted by facility. From rlEstabAtendPrestConv.
example_queries: SELECT f.trade_name, at.agreement_name FROM mcp_test.facility_agreements fa JOIN mcp_test.facilities f ON fa.facility_id = f.facility_id JOIN mcp_test.agreement_types at ON fa.agreement_code = at.agreement_code WHERE at.agreement_name = 'PARTICULAR' AND f.deactivation_reason_code IS NULL LIMIT 10

columns.name: quantity
columns.comment: Number of units; use quantity > 0 with operational_status = E

columns.name: operational_status
columns.comment: E=In use, D=Inactive, M=Maintenance. Filter E for active equipment.

example_queries: SELECT f.trade_name, fe.equipment_code, fe.quantity FROM mcp_test.facility_equipment fe JOIN mcp_test.facilities f ON fe.facility_id = f.facility_id WHERE fe.operational_status = 'E' AND f.deactivation_reason_code IS NULL LIMIT 10

facility_physical_installations.description: Physical installations at each facility. From rlEstabInstFisiAssist.

facility_professionals.description: Links professionals to facilities - WHO WORKS WHERE. ~864k rows.

columns.name: occupation_code
columns.comment: CBO code indicating specialty/role (e.g. physician, nurse)

columns.name: termination_date
columns.comment: NULL = currently employed, NOT NULL = terminated

example_queries: SELECT fp.facility_id, p.full_name, o.occupation_name FROM mcp_test.facility_professionals fp JOIN mcp_test.professionals p ON fp.professional_id = p.professional_id JOIN mcp_test.occupations o ON fp.occupation_code = o.occupation_code WHERE fp.termination_date IS NULL LIMIT 10

facility_representatives.description: Official legal representatives at facilities. From rlEstabRepresentante.

columns.name: tax_id
columns.comment: CPF when provided; CNES often masks as literal CO_CPF (stored NULL).

example_queries: SELECT f.trade_name, fr.representative_name, fr.role_title, fr.email FROM mcp_test.facility_representatives fr JOIN mcp_test.facilities f ON fr.facility_id = f.facility_id WHERE f.deactivation_reason_code IS NULL AND fr.email IS NOT NULL LIMIT 10
SELECT representative_name, role_title, email FROM mcp_test.facility_search_view WHERE state_code = 'SP' AND representative_email IS NOT NULL LIMIT 10

facility_services.description: Services and specialties offered by facilities.

columns.name: owner_tax_id
columns.comment: CNPJ/CPF of service provider at this facility (CO_CNPJCPF)

columns.name: address_complement
columns.comment: Address complement distinguishing multiple service locations (CO_END_COMPL)

columns.name: is_active
columns.comment: 1 = service currently active at this facility

facility_types.description: Types of health facilities (hospital, clinic, pharmacy, etc.). Lookup for facilities.facility_type_code.

maintainers.description: Facility maintainer organizations (mantenedora). Full record from tbMantenedora.

municipalities.description: Brazilian municipalities (cities). ~5,600 rows. Join via municipality_id.
example_queries: SELECT m.municipality_name, s.state_code FROM mcp_test.municipalities m JOIN mcp_test.states s ON m.state_code = s.state_code WHERE s.state_code = 'SP' LIMIT 10
SELECT occupation_code, occupation_name FROM mcp_test.occupations WHERE occupation_name ILIKE '%DERMAT%' LIMIT 10

SELECT p.full_name, o.occupation_name FROM mcp_test.facility_professionals fp JOIN mcp_test.professionals p ON fp.professional_id = p.professional_id JOIN mcp_test.occupations o ON fp.occupation_code = o.occupation_code WHERE o.occupation_code = '225135' AND fp.termination_date IS NULL LIMIT 10

physical_installations.description: Physical installation catalog (consulting rooms, clinics). From tbInstalFisicaParaAssist.

professional_workload.description: Working hours, credentials, and professional licenses.

columns.name: service_type
columns.comment: S=SUS, N=non-SUS. Part of composite PK — same professional can have separate SUS and non-SUS workloads.

columns.name: employment_type_code
columns.comment: Part of composite PK with facility, professional, occupation

columns.name: professional_council_code
columns.comment: CNES council code (generic 01-12 or regional CRM 60-83). Not FK-constrained — tbConselhoClasse only lists 12 generic types.

example_queries: SELECT pw.facility_id, pw.professional_id, pw.occupation_code, pw.service_type, pw.weekly_hours_ambulatory FROM mcp_test.professional_workload pw WHERE pw.facility_id = '...' LIMIT 10

columns.name: social_name
columns.comment: Preferred/social name if different from legal name

example_queries: SELECT professional_id, full_name FROM mcp_test.professionals WHERE full_name ILIKE '%SILVA%' LIMIT 10

service_classifications.description: Detailed service classification hierarchy linked to service_specialties.

service_specialties.description: Medical service specialties. Lookup for facility_services.service_code.

example_queries: SELECT state_code, state_name FROM mcp_test.states ORDER BY state_name

active_facilities.description: Active facilities only (deactivation_reason_code IS NULL) with location and type.
active_facilities.use_when: Simple active facility list without aggregations

active_facility_professionals.description: Currently employed professionals at active facilities.

facility_equipment_in_use.description: Equipment currently in use at active facilities (operational_status=E, quantity>0).

facility_search_view.description: Pre-aggregated facility search with staff, services, equipment counts. Prefer for sales discovery.
example_queries: SELECT trade_name, state_code, active_professionals_count FROM mcp_test.facility_search_view WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND state_code = 'SP' ORDER BY active_professionals_count DESC LIMIT 20
facility_search_view.use_when: Discovery queries by state, equipment, staff size

professional_search_view.description: Pre-aggregated professional search: employment, licenses, locations. Prefer for discovery queries.
professional_search_view.use_when: Finding professionals by location or specialty (use occupation_names or join occupations)
